items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: And the boy who played -- who plays with Merv Griffin now.

ctx.x: They immortalize this guy. You couldn't put Bix Beiderbecke on a bandstand if you had a derrick and lift him up there. When them cats, when all them trumpet players got to playing, what can you do. He stopped -- tear him up (unintelligible) He was a good friend of mine, Bix was, because everytime we went to Davenport, I would go out to see his people. I hear 'em talk about this guy and that guy, it's a living joke man. It's a masquerade, because you don't have to go hunting for them. You could walk by a little…

These cats -- they don't do nothing. You get one of those chicks, with the $3.00 hair, get a $3.00 guitar and she go out and sing the water's wet, the wind is blowing and right away I see a guy like Merv Griffin, Mike Douglas and
